purpose: Internal-alpha traceability requirements for the installed image
requiredAtImageBuild: exact installed package NEVRAs and source repositories
exact COPR build identifiers or an explicit unresolved blocker
exact installed Flatpak refs and commits
mutableInputs: enabled COPR repositories are externally mutable until exact build records are captured
Flathub application resolution is externally mutable until exact refs and commits are captured
releasePolicy: An internal image may be inspected with unresolved records; public release claims require complete records.
